notes.title: Steam Next fest and release date reveal!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello chefs![/h2]

Oh, we have so much good news for you today 👀✨

Cook For Love has an official release date! [b]21st of November is the date![/b] 🎉🎉

On top of that, we're taking part in Steam Next Fest - we have a demo ready to go for anyone who’d like to check out the basics of prepping homey dishes 😤🥗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/46f3542dbfc8684007a41b110e8f7de38f410ff9.jpg[/img]

We’re still working on the post-playtest feedback but we're also setting up a stream so you can already see big changes coming to the narrative side of the game!

if you want to share your thoughts you can tweet @TMYS_Official ❣

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Backstories and Puzzles
notes.content:
[h2][b]  Hello again, young chefs! 🐾🐶

We’ve been cooking up a storm!

Welcome to Cook For Love’s third Devlog – 📚Backstories and Puzzles🧩 [/b][/h2]

This will mean that we’re going to talk about Clement’s cooking adventures, as well as his to-be wife and the universe of Tell Me Your Story.

At the end of the devlog there will be some information about upcoming changes in Cook For Love based on your playtest feedback 🎮 Thank you so much for everyone who has given their feedback! If anyone else wants to take part in the playtest – come on in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/7ede49f0cc44abcd6f103c0c6a53f0ed334dafc8.gif[/img]

Let’s start with Clement’s cooking adventure. What happened in his life before he met Rose on the Orient Express? Was he fated to be a masterful cook?

Well, he actually ended up in Jean-Luc Chatillon’s restaurant because of a newspaper ad. He did not have much confidence in his skills, and in the end, he was left to care for the restaurant’s kitchen alone… with Jean-Luc’s recipe book as his only guide.

Well, the master chef believed that “time is the best teacher” and that the first person who answered his newspaper ad would be the right one. Clement does turn out to be the perfect candidate, and with the help of kind neighbors, he’s able to climb to the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/8463652c9933fda067d6236bc04b5e0929ed3773.png[/img]

Cook For Love and its predecessor – Tell Me Your Story have more in common than Clement’s character. Players of TMYS got glimpses of our amateur cook in the Orient Express chapter of the story and will easily recognize the cozy art style. Besides shared aesthetics and characters, there are also mechanics that the two games share. The fans of our puzzle game will definitely be familiar with some in-game controls and environment interactions.

The familiar UI was reshaped to include new functions and additional recipe-related instructions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/7f5c0a521c31c66ca04bc1807fd215e35ad39745.png[/img]

The recipes in Cook For Love are quite simple even if their difficulty ramps up with each new cooking level that Clement achieves. From smoothies and dinners to cakes and pizzas – these dishes are there to promote a healthy approach to eating and ease players into the world of cooking. Many meals can be made from easily accessible ingredients and balance out the diet of anyone who’d like to spend some time on home-cooked meals.
After his cooking adventures and meeting Rose during his Orient Express days, Clement settles down. That doesn’t mean he’s not a busy man! He has a creative and curious granddaughter to spend time with and plenty of adventures that she’d like to know.
For those cooking fans who like puzzles just as much as food, Tell Me Your Story will give more context as to how Clement and Rose met, as well as who is his adventurous other half. All is shown through the eyes of Amelia – their granddaughter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/c5cf991d68c6540cb35ce9a6c9479dbec9d3df5a.gif[/img]

[h3] Our devs already made a little list of upcoming changes based on your feedback:

Moving the narrative of reopening the restaurant to the foreground.
You’ll hear more about living in Paris from the new customers visiting Clement’s restaurant.
The possibility of looking into the dining area of the restaurant.
Reactions to and dialogue about the delicious dishes from customers.

If you’d like to take part in the playtest it’s available on Cook For Love’s Steam page 🐶❣


Thank you for reading Devlog #3 📚Backstories and Puzzles🧩! Next time we will talk about art and visuals, as well as the delicious-looking animations 🍰✨[/h3]

[h2]  Peanut out~ [/h2]

notes.title: Cozy game about cooking, with a heart-touching story? It's Cook For Love!
notes.content:
[h2][b] Hey! We're announcing new cozy cooking game coming soon – Cook For Love ❤️ Just like its predecessor – Tell Me Your Story (yes, they are conected!), the game will be available on both Steam and Nintendo consoles! Read more below! ✨[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/30b4cceb4806e5c027d5c2909ab12ff5c222dde4.png[/img]

One faithful evening in Paris, a young Frenchman called Clement visited the restaurant of Jean-Luc Chatillone. He was hired on the spot and given access to the master chef’s cookbook – a treasure in itself. 
From that point all that Clement had to do is roll up his sleeves and learn all the recipes, all the while his mentor was cooking delicacies for the people onboard the Orient Express...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/7d0c4d3bb1355efdbfa20ef4cd6956dc19cd3993.jpg[/img]

Similar to Tell Me Your Story, Cook For Love is a story focused around the career of Grandpa Clement before he became a chef we know and love. It was made by the same team that worked on the cozy puzzle game that was released in April! 😍

Cook For Love offers a wide array of recipes that players can make with their own hands. From tomato juice and hot cocoa to pizzas and pastas, all delicious meals will be unlocked as the game progresses. 
Together with Clement, players will climb to earn higher cooking ranks and make their own mark on the world, starting with Jean-Luc Chatillone’s regulars ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046373/4e07006df28284b9d7be5a16329dc77e12930fed.jpg[/img]

Cook for Love will contain 40 recipes of varying complexity, waiting for players to prepare them. All are presented in a fancy way with beautiful, hand-drawn visuals and lively colors. Those who like accuracy in their cooking challenges won’t be disappointed. Additionally, fans of Tell Me Your Story will recognise the art style and coziness ☕

Cook For Love will be available on Steam and the Nintendo Switch in 2024, and the game is currently open to wishlists on Steam. The release date of the game will be announced at a later date! 

[h2]See ya! ❤️❤️❤️[/h2]
